title: 草莓怎么卖？
description_uz: «Sal arzonroq bo'lmaydimi?» — bozorda meva sotib olish haqidagi suhbat. Bu dialog narxni so'rash, savdolashish, tortib berishni so'rash va qaytimni hisoblashni mashq qiladi.
description_ru: «А подешевле можно?» — разговор о покупке фруктов на рынке. Этот диалог отрабатывает, как спросить цену, поторговаться, попросить взвесить и посчитать сдачу.
description_en: «Could you make it a bit cheaper?» — buying fruit at the market. This dialogue practises asking a price, haggling, asking to be weighed out an amount, and working out the change.

sentences.text_translation_en: Hello, how much are the strawberries?
sentences.speaker: A

sentences.pinyin: Cǎoméi bā kuài qián yì jīn.
sentences.text_translation_ru: Клубника — восемь юаней за пол кило.
sentences.text_translation_en: Strawberries are eight yuan for half a kilo.
sentences.speaker: B

sentences.text_translation_en: Could you make it a bit cheaper?
sentences.speaker: A

sentences.text_original: 这个很新鲜，不能再便宜了。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège hěn xīnxiān, bù néng zài piányi le.
sentences.text_translation: Bu juda yangi, bundan arzon bo'lmaydi.
sentences.text_translation_ru: Она очень свежая, дешевле не могу.
sentences.text_translation_en: These are very fresh, I can't go any lower.
sentences.speaker: B

sentences.pinyin: Nà gěi wǒ chēng liǎng jīn ba.
sentences.text_translation: Unda menga bir kilo tortib bering.
sentences.text_translation_en: Then weigh me out a kilo.
sentences.speaker: A

sentences.pinyin: Hǎo de, hái yào biéde ma?
sentences.speaker: B

sentences.text_translation_ru: Сколько стоят мандарины за пол кило?
sentences.text_translation_en: How much are the tangerines for half a kilo?
sentences.speaker: A

sentences.pinyin: Júzi sì kuài qián yì jīn.
sentences.text_translation_ru: Мандарины — четыре юаня за пол кило.
sentences.text_translation_en: Tangerines are four yuan for half a kilo.
sentences.speaker: B

sentences.text_translation_en: Then give me half a kilo of tangerines.
sentences.speaker: A

sentences.text_original: 草莓两斤十六块，橘子四块，一共二十块。
sentences.pinyin: Cǎoméi liǎng jīn shíliù kuài, júzi sì kuài, yígòng èrshí kuài.
sentences.text_translation: Bir kilo qulupnay o'n olti yuan, mandarin to'rt yuan, hammasi bo'lib yigirma yuan.
sentences.text_translation_ru: Килограмм клубники — шестнадцать юаней, мандарины — четыре, всего двадцать юаней.
sentences.text_translation_en: A kilo of strawberries is sixteen yuan, the tangerines four, twenty yuan altogether.
sentences.speaker: B
